newsitem.title: UK: Prompt cargo overhang weakens Dated Brent further.
newsitem.headline: Prompt cargo overhang weakens Dated Brent further.

text.p: An overhang of prompt cargoes saw values for Dated Brent weakening further while forward paper spreads softened a little in late business after tracking Brent futures for much of the day, traders said.

A September 19-21 Brent max cargo was sold by a trader to a U.K. refiner at Oct -30 cents, some 13 cents lower than trade earlier in the week. Traders said the market was offered over at this level in late business with best bids around Oct -35 cents.
Benchmark October Brent paper shed early gains after futures fell from post-Gulf War highs on profit-taking. Paper spreads weakened a little after tracking futures for much of the day.
